presentation.label: MIDI CC to effect page 2
presentation.summary: Map MIDI CC 68–73 to FX1 SETUP controls on audio tracks. Uses no effect slot.
presentation.overview: CC Map maps incoming MIDI CCs on audio tracks' trig channels to effect page-2 parameters, respecting AUDIO CC IN and clamping values. It writes Part, live and shadow values and marks the Part changed.
highlights: CC 68–73 address FX1 page-2 slots 6–11 for a non-NONE FX1.
Writes every audio track whose trig channel matches the message.
Clamps values using the target effect's parameter limits.
Passes CCs outside 62–73 to the next handler.
usage: On the verified MKII emulator panel, press PROJ, choose MIDI, press RIGHT, choose CONTROL and press YES. Enable AUDIO CC IN with LEVEL.
In MIDI > CHANNELS, match the target audio track’s TRIG CH to the controller. The captured T1 uses channel 1, independently of AUTO CH 11.
Select T1 and FILTER in FUNC+FX1 SETUP. Send CC 68 value 1 on channel 1, then close/reopen SETUP: HP changes from 12 dB to 24 dB. Physical audio and save/reload behavior remain untested.

access.location: MKII: PROJ > MIDI > CONTROL enables AUDIO CC IN; MIDI > CHANNELS sets the audio track’s TRIG CH. FUNC+FX1 opens effect page-2 SETUP.
steps: On the MKII panel, press PROJ. Select MIDI with UP/DOWN and press RIGHT to enter its list.
Select CONTROL and press YES. Select AUDIO CC IN and turn LEVEL until its checkbox is enabled.
Press NO to return to MIDI, select CHANNELS and press YES. Match the target audio track’s TRIG CH to the external controller. The captured T1 uses channel 1; AUTO CH 11 is a different setting.
Press NO twice to return to the track. Press T1, then hold FUNC and press FX1 for FX1 SETUP. Turn LEVEL to FILTER and press YES to assign it.
FILTER SETUP shows page-2 HP, LP, ENV, HOLD, Q and DIST. Send CC 68 value 1 on channel 1 to change HP from 12 dB to 24 dB.
Close SETUP with FX1 and reopen with FUNC+FX1 to refresh the displayed HP value.
The steps and incoming CC example were verified on the actual MKII emulator LCD. Physical audio, Part save/reload and MKI navigation remain untested.

limitations: CC 62–67 write FX2 page 2 only for BusDelay/BusVerb, which are outside scope and not imported. Current catalog/stock FX2 support is not claimed.
CC 62–73 are consumed even if AUDIO CC IN is disabled or the track's effect has no eligible target.
Upstream MODE DEFAULTS and SCENES KITS overrides are not imported or enabled.
Upstream leaves hardware SCENES KITS chaining and FX1-to-DSP updates on THRU tracks open.
Released with owner approval for software verification only: real hardware stress and chip worst-case timing are untested/unmeasured. The waiver covers this version only.

Browser builds match native composition for the currently buildable modules, including Repitch, Scale Quantizer and USB Audio/MIDI. MIDI Scenes is a separate pending update; OctaKit remains outside the catalog.

storage.label: Authored ROM allocation
storage.conditions: One shared ROM allocation, no per-track code copies or new heap/global state. Native alignment reserves up to 127 padding bytes; actual selected placement is checked against free space. See the exact region/accounting report.

processing.label: ColdFire MIDI processing
processing.conditions: Real-chip worst-case cycles and deadline/headroom under contention are unmeasured. Owner-approved exact-version release waiver; emulator and assembly checks are not chip timing.

impact.conditions: One shared handler with up to eight audio tracks; dense incoming MIDI control or rapid Flex/Static previews. Estimates describe added module work and do not promise timing headroom.

cpu.rationale: Event-driven ColdFire code; no added DSP algorithm or per-sample DSP work. At most eight track iterations per incoming CC.

dsp.rationale: No authored DSP code, tables, buffers or additional effect slots. Existing stock processing still applies.

memory.rationale: 724 authored ROM bytes, up to 127 alignment bytes, no newly allocated heap or persistent RAM. Existing stock state is reused.

tests.summary: Native/browser byte parity passed for all 1,024 supported selections: 522 exact images and 502 matching refusals. Eight full native upgrades and actual browser downloads match. Authored assembly/relocation and MKII LCD documentation checked. Physical stress, audio behavior and chip timing remain untested/unmeasured under the owner’s exact-version waiver.

releaseWaiver.reason: Owner explicitly approved these two modules with software verification, no physical hardware run and chip timing marked unmeasured. Applies only to the pinned complete source version.

tutorial.title: Try an FX1 setup parameter
steps: Enable AUDIO CC IN in PROJ > MIDI > CONTROL. In MIDI > CHANNELS, set T1’s TRIG CH to 1 and send from the controller on channel 1.
Select T1 and FILTER in FUNC+FX1 SETUP. Send CC 68 value 1 on channel 1 to change the first setup parameter, HP, from 12 dB to 24 dB.
Close SETUP with FX1 and reopen with FUNC+FX1 to refresh the display. Send CC 68 value 0 to restore 12 dB; disable AUDIO CC IN to stop incoming control.
